title: What is a Broker?
description: Learn how you actually place trades in the real world.

slides.title: The Middleman
slides.content: You can't just walk into the stock exchange and buy shares. You need a broker—a middleman who is licensed to trade on the exchange.

slides.title: Types of Brokers
slides.content: There are traditional full-service brokers (who give advice) and discount brokers (apps like Robinhood, Zerodha) which let you trade cheaply yourself.

slides.title: Brokerage Accounts
slides.content: To start trading, you open a brokerage account, deposit money, and place orders through their app or website.

options.text: A licensed middleman who places trades for you
options.explanation: Brokers execute trades on your behalf.

options.text: The owner of the stock exchange
